row: 墾丁國家公園位於恆春半島南端，1984 年 1 月 1 日成立，是臺灣第一座國家公園，也是臺灣本島唯一的熱帶區域。範圍包含陸地與海域，有隆起的珊瑚礁、龍鑾潭、龍磐草原，以及 1883 年點燈的鵝鑾鼻燈塔。

title.zh-Hant: 燈塔、墾荒者與第一座國家公園
title.en: A Lighthouse, Settlers and the First National Park

tagline.zh-Hant: 從十九世紀的船難到1984年
tagline.en: From the shipwrecks of the nineteenth century to 1984

zh: 鵝鑾鼻，是臺灣本島的最南端。
en: Cape Eluanbi is the southernmost point of Taiwan's main island.

zh: 岬角外有七星岩暗礁與強勁的海流，
十九世紀常有船隻在這裡失事。
en: The Qixingyan reefs and strong currents lie off the cape;
in the nineteenth century ships were often wrecked here.

zh: 船難引發1867年的羅發號事件與1874年日本出兵，
美、日兩國要求清廷在此建燈塔。
en: Wrecks led to the Rover incident of 1867 and a Japanese expedition in 1874;
the United States and Japan pressed the Qing to build a lighthouse.

zh: 1875年買下土地，1881年動工，
1883年4月1日點燈。
en: The land was bought in 1875, work began in 1881,
and the light first shone on 1 April 1883.

zh: 工程由海關聘請的英國工程師負責，
清廷派了五百名士兵保護工地。
en: A British engineer of the Maritime Customs ran the work,
guarded by 500 Qing soldiers.

zh: 燈塔四周有壕溝與槍眼，
是島上唯一的武裝燈塔。
en: Ringed by a ditch and pierced with gunports,
it was the only armed lighthouse on the island.

zh: 它在甲午戰爭與二次大戰中兩度受損，
en: It was badly damaged in the Sino-Japanese War and again in the Second World War,
then repaired in 1898 and rebuilt in 1947.

zh: 1877年，清廷從廣東潮州一帶招募壯丁來此墾荒，
「墾丁」因此得名。
en: In 1877 the Qing recruited men from Chaozhou in Guangdong to clear this land;
that is how Kenting got its name.

zh: 1906年，日本人在這片高地
設立恆春熱帶植物園。
en: In 1906 the Japanese founded the Hengchun Tropical Botanical Garden
on this high ground.

zh: 1984年1月1日，墾丁國家公園成立，
是臺灣第一座國家公園。
en: On 1 January 1984 Kenting National Park was established,
Taiwan's first national park.

zh: 公園涵蓋恆春、車城與滿州三個鄉鎮。
en: The park takes in Hengchun, Checheng and Manzhou townships.

zh: 鵝鑾鼻公園對外開放。
en: Eluanbi Park opened to the public
on 25 December 1982.

zh: 現在的燈塔高21.4公尺，
燈光可以照到27.2浬外。
en: The present tower is 21.4 metres tall,
and its light reaches 27.2 nautical miles.

zh: 一座為了船難而蓋的燈塔，
後來成了國家公園的地標。
en: A lighthouse built because of shipwrecks
became the landmark of a national park.

title.en: A Peninsula under the Light of East Asia

tagline.zh-Hant: 地名、燈塔看守人、音樂祭與社區
tagline.en: Place names, a lightkeeper, a music festival and a community

zh: 墾丁在屏東縣恆春半島的南端，三面環海。
en: Kenting lies at the southern end of the Hengchun Peninsula in Pingtung, with the sea on three sides.

zh: 「墾丁」這個地名的意思，
是來開墾的壯丁。
en: The name Kenting
means the men who came to clear the land.

zh: 往北是恆春，
半島就以它為名。
en: To the north is Hengchun,
the town that gives the peninsula its name.

zh: 恆春古城與瓊麻工業歷史展示區，
是公園介紹的人文景點。
en: The old walled town of Hengchun and the Sisal Industry Historical Exhibition
are among the park's cultural sites.

zh: 龍鑾潭西岸有一座自然中心，
展示臺灣的鳥類生態。
en: A nature centre on the western shore of Longluan Lake
presents Taiwan's bird life.

zh: 再往東南，回到半島尖端的鵝鑾鼻。
en: South-east again, to Eluanbi at the tip of the peninsula.

zh: 鵝鑾鼻燈塔的光力是全臺最強，
被稱為「東亞之光」。
en: Eluanbi's light is the most intense in Taiwan;
it is known as the Light of East Asia.

zh: 第一任看守人泰勒在這裡待到1889年，
還學會了排灣語。
en: Its first keeper, George Taylor, served here until 1889
and learned the Paiwan language.

zh: 船帆石、青蛙石與大尖山，
公園都規定不可以攀爬。
en: Sail Rock, Frog Rock and Mount Dajian
are all closed to climbing under park rules.

zh: 船帆石立在海岸邊，
名字來自它像船帆的形狀。
en: Sail Rock stands at the edge of the shore,
named for its sail-like shape.

zh: 每年三月的「春天吶喊」音樂祭，
從1995年辦到現在。
en: The Spring Scream rock festival
has been held here every March since 1995.

zh: 電影《海角七號》與《少年Pi的奇幻漂流》，
都有部分在這裡拍攝。
en: The films Cape No. 7 and Life of Pi
were both partly shot here.

zh: 森林遊樂區旁的社頂社區，
二十年來是公園社區生態旅遊的先驅。
en: The Sheding community beside the forest recreation area
has pioneered the park's community ecotourism for two decades.

zh: 2016年，有584萬人次來到這座國家公園。
en: In 2016 the national park received 5.84 million visits.

title.zh-Hant: 陸蟹、過境鷹與礁上的森林
title.en: Land Crabs, Passing Hawks and a Forest on the Reef

tagline.zh-Hant: 臺灣本島唯一的熱帶區域
tagline.en: The only tropical corner of Taiwan's main island

zh: 墾丁，是臺灣本島唯一的熱帶區域。
en: Kenting is the only tropical region on Taiwan's main island.

zh: 公園總面積三萬三千多公頃，
陸地與海域大約各占一半。
en: The park covers more than 33,000 hectares,
roughly half land and half sea.

zh: 墾丁森林遊樂區是一片「高位珊瑚礁森林」，
樹木直接長在隆起的礁岩上。
en: The Kenting forest recreation area is an "uplifted coral reef forest":
trees grow straight out of raised reef rock.

zh: 茄苳緊抓著礁岩，銀葉樹長出板根，
白榕垂下無數氣根。
en: Bishopwood trees grip the reef, looking-glass trees spread buttress roots,
and white banyans drop countless aerial roots.

zh: 這裡常見臺灣獼猴與赤腹松鼠；
每年十月，灰面鵟鷹過境。
en: Taiwan macaques and red-bellied tree squirrels are common here;
grey-faced buzzards pass through each October.

zh: 公園記錄到310種鳥
與216種蝴蝶。
en: The park has recorded 310 bird species
and 216 kinds of butterfly.

zh: 龍鑾潭面積175公頃、平均水深3.5公尺，
冬天是候鳥的棲地。
en: Longluan Lake covers 175 hectares and averages 3.5 metres deep;
in winter it shelters migratory birds.

zh: 潭在低窪處，雨季容易淹水，
東、北兩側因此築了堤。
en: The lake lies low and floods in the rainy season,
so barriers were built on its east and north sides.

zh: 公園裡有26種陸蟹，
被稱為全世界單一地區陸蟹種類最多的地方。
en: The park has 26 species of land crab,
said to be the highest diversity in any single area in the world.

zh: 周圍的海裡，
有玳瑁、鬼蝠魟與鯨鯊。
en: The surrounding sea
is home to hawksbill turtles, manta rays and whale sharks.

zh: 梅花鹿1969年在野外絕跡，
1994年重新野放到這裡。
en: The Formosan sika deer died out in the wild in 1969
and was reintroduced here in 1994.

zh: 公園的北部是山區，
南仁湖就在那裡。
en: The north of the park is hill country,
where Nanren Lake lies.

zh: 龍磐的草原、風吹砂的沙丘植物、
鵝鑾鼻的海濱植物，各有不同的植群。
en: The grassland of Longpan, the dune plants of Fengchuisha
and the shore plants of Eluanbi each form a different community.

zh: 在這個熱帶的尖端，
海、礁、森林與候鳥擠在同一塊土地上。
en: On this tropical tip,
sea, reef, forest and migrants share one piece of land.

title.en: Coral Reef Lifted out of the Sea

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩個岬角、一片縱谷與五十萬年的隆起
tagline.en: Two capes, a valley plain and half a million years of uplift

zh: 恆春半島三面臨海：
東邊太平洋、西邊臺灣海峽、南邊巴士海峽。
en: The Hengchun Peninsula meets the sea on three sides:
the Pacific to the east, the Taiwan Strait to the west, the Bashi Channel to the south.

zh: 貓鼻頭是南灣的西界，
隔著海灣與東南方的鵝鑾鼻相對。
en: Cape Maobitou forms the western edge of South Bay,
facing Cape Eluanbi to the south-east.

zh: 兩個岬角之間的這片海，就是南灣。
en: The water between the two capes is South Bay.

zh: 鵝鑾鼻燈塔的燈，
高出海面56.4公尺。
en: The light of Eluanbi Lighthouse
stands 56.4 metres above the sea.

zh: 往北是龍磐公園，
一片朝東面向太平洋的開闊草原。
en: To the north is Longpan Park,
an open grassland facing east over the Pacific.

zh: 草原上經常颳著強風；
西邊是臺地與珊瑚礁崖。
en: Strong winds often sweep the grassland;
to the west are terraces and coral reef cliffs.

zh: 大約五十萬年前，
板塊運動把海裡的珊瑚礁抬出水面。
en: About 500,000 years ago,
plate movement lifted the coral reef out of the sea.

zh: 礁岩裡有鐘乳石與石筍，
例如銀龍洞與石筍寶穴。
en: Inside the reef rock are stalactites and stalagmites,
in caves such as Silver Dragon Cave and Stalagmite Cave.

zh: 從上面看，森林蓋住了整塊隆起的礁岩。
en: From above, forest covers the whole block of raised reef.

zh: 西海岸是珊瑚礁海崖與裙礁，
北部是山地，南部是珊瑚礁臺地。
en: The west coast has coral cliffs and fringing reefs;
mountains lie to the north and coral tablelands to the south.

zh: 中間是恆春縱谷平原，
龍鑾潭就在這片低地上。
en: Between them runs the Hengchun Longitudinal Valley Plain,
with Longluan Lake on its low ground.

zh: 半島大部分地勢低於八百公尺，
海風很容易吹過整片土地。
en: Most of the peninsula lies below 800 metres,
so sea winds cross it easily.

zh: 這裡是熱帶季風氣候；
冬天的落山風甚至會影響恆春機場的航班。
en: The climate is tropical monsoon;
in winter, downslope winds even disrupt flights at Hengchun Airport.

zh: 珊瑚在海裡長成的石頭，
如今是臺灣最南端的陸地。
en: Rock that corals built under the sea
is now the southernmost land of Taiwan's main island.
